mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, COLLECTION_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, COLLECTION_ID DESC

SELECT c.COLLECTION_ID, c.TITLE, c.DESCRIPTION, c.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(cl.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LIKED_DT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE cl JOIN COLLECTION c ON cl.COLLECTION_ID = c.COLLECTION_ID WHERE cl.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ( c.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' OR c.MEMBER_ID = #{currentMemberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) ORDER BY cl.CREATED_DT DESC, c.COLLECTION_ID DESC OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT MEMBER_ID, COLLECTION_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, MEMBER_ID DESC
